title: CLI contract X17b: one versioned envelope, one exit-code table, --json and --project-root on each core verb, and a registry guard
summary: 112 verbs and no contract document (research F4.1). Many core verbs print prose only and no JSON has a schema version (F4.2). Usage errors exit 1 in loop-stop and inbox-mover and 10 in gc, loop status and quality (F4.3). inbox list|show|rank|add|edit|withdraw|consume and signals tail have no --project-root (F4.8). Spec: docs/architecture/cli-contract.md §2, §3, §5, §7.
fix: Add one envelope writer (schema, ok, data, error, warnings) and one exit-code table (0 ok, 1 failed, 2 io, 3 refused, 4 queued, 10 usage, 11 input) in cmd/evolve. Give each core verb of cli-contract.md §5 --json and --project-root. inbox add needs --file - for stdin. A verb that changes a code keeps the old code for one release with a WARN line. Add TestCLIContract_DocMatchesTheRegistry, TestCLIContract_EachCoreVerbPrintsOneEnvelope and TestCLIContract_AlwaysVerbsWriteNothing.
acceptance: RED first: TestCLIContract_DocMatchesTheRegistry parses cli-contract.md §5 and §6 and fails on inbox list with no --project-root
Each core verb of §5 prints exactly one envelope with a schema field on each exit and exits with a code of §3; the table test has one success, one usage and one refusal case for each verb
Each always verb leaves the tree hash of a temp root unchanged
Changed functions at 100% coverage; cli-contract.md 'today' columns and runtime-reference.md updated; CHANGELOG lists each changed exit code
